snippet.title: Dino Quest - Dinosaur Game for iPhone and Android
snippet.description:
Download on the App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/dino-quest-dinosaur-fossil/id682455707?mt=8
Download on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=br.com.tapps.dinoquest

Explore different continents to find the fossils of million of years of history and bring them to your own museum collection. With accurate information and an exciting gameplay, Dino Quest is the definitive app for every dinosaur fan.

Like our page on Facebook and get gifts and Promo Codes for our games! http://www.facebook.com/tappshq

A game by Tapps Games!
